description.content: Drags the tabset it is rendered within; render it within the content returned by the Workspace's renderTabsetToolbar prop:

renderTabsetToolbar={() => (
<TabsetDragHandle>⠿</TabsetDragHandle>
)}

By default, a tabset is dragged by the empty space in its header; once its header contains a drag handle, only the handle drags it. Any element with a data-tabset-drag-handle attribute is a drag handle; this component also sets touch-action: none, so that it can be dragged by touch.
The handle has a data-disabled attribute when the tabset can't be dragged (see useParentTabsetState), e.g. to hide it.
